update.available: Version {available} is available on the {channel} channel; this installation runs {running}

blockedBy.contract: The update crosses a contract boundary
blockedBy.min_upgrade_from: The running version is below the minimum the channel upgrades from

error.channel: The release channel at {url} could not be read: {reason}
error.channel_insecure: The channel address {url} in the update section is plain http; a release channel is read over https, and insecure_rehearsal_channel admits http for a rehearsal channel only
error.channel_url: The channel address {url} in the update section is not an http or https address
error.contract: The change from {running} (contract {runningContract}) to {target} (contract {targetContract}) crosses a contract boundary; roll back with a restore from the privileged command line
error.contract_unknown: The channel has no manifest for version {version}, so its contract is unknown
error.head_expired: The head of the channel at {url} expired at {expiresAt}; an expired head is not trusted, so try again later or use another channel
error.head_no_expiry: The head of the channel at {url} carries no expiry; a head without one is not trusted, so try again later or use another channel
error.history: The recorded run {id} names the version {version}, which does not parse
error.inline: The update runs as a task; call it through the task runner
error.manifest: The channel answered something that is not a release manifest at {url}: {reason}
error.min_upgrade_from: Version {target} cannot be reached from {running}: the channel upgrades from {minUpgradeFrom} at least
error.no_previous: No update to {running} is recorded, so there is no version to roll back to
error.not_started: The update module has not started
error.request: The update request {path} could not be written: {reason}
error.up_to_date: This installation runs {running}; the channel offers {available}, so there is nothing to update
error.version: The running version {version} is not a semantic version

progress.drain: Waiting for running tasks to finish
progress.dump: Taking the pre-update dump of the database
progress.request: Writing the update request for the root unit
